test_title: PYST 50: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**perhaps**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4 is: **perhaps**.
 
• The sentence structure **suggests the possibility of Korean shoppers being among the world's most discerning**, and "**perhaps**" is used to indicate uncertainty or probability in this context.
 
• **Options 2), 3), and 4) (although, maybe, though) **don't serve the same function as "**perhaps**" in **expressing uncertainty or likelihood in this sentence. **They either introduce contrasting information **(although, though)** or express possibility without the same level of uncertainty **(maybe). **

 

Correct Passage:__ *South Korea is the most cosmetically advanced country on Earth. Beauty editors estimate that it is because of the government’s heavy investment in the industry. It is ahead of its competitors, and its citizens spend twice as much on skincare products as consumers in the United States, the UK, and France. Korean shoppers are **perhaps** the world’s most discerning. Eight out of 10 Korean women in their 20s and 30s use an app that (5)_____ like a cosmetics-specific, to debate the merits of various common ingredients.*
